pois.name: Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion
pois.intro: The Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion is a government gazetted heritage building located on Leith Street in George Town, Penang, Malaysia. The mansion's external decorations and indigo-blue outer walls make it a very distinctive building, and it is sometimes referred to as The Blue Mansion.

pois.name: Pinang Peranakan Mansion
pois.intro: The Pinang Peranakan Mansion in George Town, Penang, Malaysia, is a museum dedicated to Penang's Peranakan heritage. The museum itself is housed within a distinctive green-hued mansion at Church Street, George Town, which once served as the residence and office of a 19th-century Chinese tycoon, Chung Keng Quee.

pois.name: Auntie Gaik Lean's Old School Eatery
Jambatan Pulau Pinang
pois.intro: The E36 Penang Bridge is a 13.5-kilometre dual carriageway toll bridge and controlled-access highway in the Malaysian state of Penang. It connects Perai on the mainland side of the state with Gelugor on the island, crossing the Penang Strait.

pois.name: Kek Lok Si Temple
pois.intro: The Kek Lok Si Temple is a Buddhist temple in George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. Located at Ayer Itam, it is the largest Buddhist temple in Malaysia and an important pilgrimage centre for Buddhists from Hong Kong, the Philippines, Singapore and other parts of Southeast Asia.

pois.name: Kota Cornwallis
pois.address: Jalan Tun Syed Sheh Barakbah, George Town, 10200
pois.intro: Fort Cornwallis is a bastion fort in George Town, Penang, Malaysia, built by the British East India Company in the late 18th century. Named after the then Lieutenant-General The 2nd Earl Cornwallis, the Governor-General of Bengal at the time of the fort's construction, it is the largest standing fort in Malaysia.

pois.name: Muzium Islam Pulau Pinang
pois.intro: The Penang Islamic Museum is a museum about Islam in George Town, Penang, Malaysia.

pois.name: Goddess of Mercy Temple
pois.address: Jalan Masjid Kapitan Keling, George Town, 10200
pois.intro: The Goddess of Mercy Temple, also known as Kuan Im Teng or Kong Hock Keong, is a Mahayana Buddhist temple within George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. Located at Pitt Street, it was built in 1800, making it the oldest Chinese temple in the state.

pois.name: Sun Yat Sen Museum Penang
pois.intro: The Sun Yat-sen Museum Penang formerly called the Sun Yat-sen Penang Base, is a museum in George Town, Penang, Malaysia. The museum is dedicated to Sun Yat-sen, a Chinese nationalist who established the Republic of China after his efforts in the Xinhai Revolution.

pois.name: Gurney Bay Phase 1
pois.intro: Gurney Bay, formerly known as Gurney Wharf, is a seafront park within George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. Intended as a "new iconic waterfront destination for Penang", the first phase of this public space off Gurney Drive was opened to public in 2024.

pois.name: Penang Botanic Gardens
pois.description: Landscaped public gardens featuring botanical exhibits, including orchids, cacti & lily ponds.
pois.intro: The Penang Botanic Gardens is a botanical garden within the city of George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. Situated at Jalan Air Terjun, it is also colloquially known as the Waterfall Gardens because of the cascading waterfall nearby.

pois.name: Penang State Museum and Art Gallery
pois.wikipedia: en:Penang State Museum and Art Gallery
pois.intro: The Penang State Museum and Art Gallery is a museum and art gallery in George Town, Penang, Malaysia.

pois.name: Camera Museum
pois.intro: The Camera Museum is a museum in George Town, Penang, Malaysia.

pois.name: Fort Cornwallis Lighthouse
pois.intro: The Fort Cornwallis Lighthouse is a lighthouse in Fort Cornwallis, George Town, Penang, Malaysia. It is currently under the management of the Maritime Authority of Malaysia.

pois.name: James Richardson Logan Monument
pois.intro: The Logan Memorial is situated in front of the Penang High Court at Light Street in George Town, Malaysia, and was erected in memory of James Richardson Logan, Scottish lawyer and man of letters, who lived in the Straits Settlements in the 19th century.

pois.name: Penang Bird Park
pois.description: Walk-in aviaries with 300+ native & exotic bird species, plus shows, feedings & a restaurant.

pois.name: Queen Victoria Memorial Clock Tower
pois.intro: The Queen Victoria Memorial in George Town, Penang is a monument to Queen Victoria, begun after her death, located at the Penang Chinese Recreation Club. Penang's Victoria Memorial takes the form of a large piece of land known as "Victoria Green," and a statue at the edge of Victoria Green at the junction of Burmah Road and Pangkor Road, the establishment of each being years apart from the other.

pois.name: Chew Jetty
pois.description: One of 5 remaining clan "jetties" - house community built on stilts - everyone here belongs to the Chew family.

pois.name: 1st Avenue Mall
pois.description: Many familiar stores & a food court offered in a contemporary, multi-level setting with a busy vibe.
pois.intro: 1st Avenue Mall is a shopping mall within George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. It is located at Magazine Road within the city's Central Business District, next to Komtar and Prangin Mall, and is linked to both buildings via overhead bridges.

pois.name: Prangin Mall
pois.address: 33 Jalan Doktor Lim Chwee Leong, George Town, 10100
pois.intro: Prangin Mall is a shopping mall within George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. It is located at Prangin Road within the city's Central Business District, next to Komtar Tower, and is linked to both Komtar and neighboring 1st Avenue Mall via overhead skybridges.

pois.name: Plaza Gurney
pois.description: Contemporary mall complex featuring clothing, electronics & accessory shops, plus a food court.
pois.intro: Gurney Plaza is a shopping mall within George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. Located at Gurney Drive within the city's Central Business District, it was opened in November 2001 and is now managed by CapitaMalls Asia, a subsidiary of the Singapore-based CapitaLand.

pois.name: Gurney Paragon Mall
pois.intro: Gurney Paragon is a mixed-use complex within George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. Situated at Gurney Drive within the city's Central Business District, it comprises twin residential towers, an office block and a nine-storey shopping mall forming the podium.

pois.name: GAMA Supermarket and Departmental Store
pois.description: Longtime, multi-floor emporium for groceries, household supplies, clothing, electronics & more.
pois.intro: GAMA is a department store within George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. Located at Dato Keramat Road within the city's Central Business District, GAMA was opened in 1967, making it the oldest department store in the Penang.

pois.name: Crafts & More Sdn Bhd
pois.address: 69 Jalan Masjid Kapitan Keling, George Town, 10200

pois.name: Taman Bandar Arkeologi Sia Boey
pois.address: 50 Jalan Doktor Lim Chwee Leong, George Town, 10100
pois.intro: The Sia Boey Urban Archaeological Park, also colloquially known as the Sia Boey, is an urban archaeology park within the city of George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. Located at Prangin Road, it is touted as the first Urban Archaeological Park in the country.

pois.name: Friendship Park
pois.description: The TPO Friendship Park is a small landscaped urban park. Opened to the public in 2011 by the Chief Minister of Penang, Lim Guan Eng.

pois.name: Taman Bandaraya Pulau Pinang (Youth Park)
pois.intro: The City Park, also colloquially known as the Youth Park, is an urban park within the city of George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. Located near the Penang Botanic Gardens, the City Park was opened in 1972 as a recreational area and a green lung for the city's residents.

pois.name: Taman Areca
pois.description: Covers 1.21 ha land. Cost RM1.52m (2021). Parking for 100 cars.

pois.name: Pusat Penerangan Pelancongan
pois.address: Jalan Tun Syed Sheh Barakbah, George Town, 10200

pois.name: Sunway Carnival Mall
pois.description: Multi-level mall with international chain shops & restaurants, a food court & a multiplex cinema.
pois.intro: Sunway Carnival Mall is a shopping mall within Seberang Perai in the Malaysian state of Penang. Located at Seberang Jaya, the 769,546 sq ft shopping centre was opened in 2007 and is one of the retail malls run by Malaysian conglomerate Sunway Group.

pois.name: Straits Quay
pois.address: Jalan Seri Tanjung Pinang, Tanjung Tokong, 10470
pois.intro: Straits Quay Retail Marina is a shopping mall-cum-marina within George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. Located at Tanjong Pinang, it was opened in 2010 and includes a marina designed for small recreational vessels, as well as a convention centre.
